decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the conservatory is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Reason for Approval

The proposed first floor side and rear extension, by way of its position, size, scale and appearance, respects the dynamics of the subject dwelling as well as the areas established built environment and would not harm neighbours living conditions or the appearance of the associated conservation area.  The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is also compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of part first floor rear extension to dwellinghouse.
